{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The '''''hal'cabure''''' (singular: ''hal'cabur''), or breastplates, were pieces of [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] that protected the chest of the wearer. The ''hal'cabure'' was split between a right piece, the ''beskad hal'cabur'', and a left piece, the ''kal hal'cabur'', which sit on either side of the ''[[Iron Heart|kar'ta beskar]]'', or Iron Heart.<ref name="TBHC">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]''</ref>
